name: HOUSING COMPLEX STRUCTURE
text: A cluster of modular habs built into the old
city ruins. Corrugated siding and mismatched
paint jobs tell the story of a community
cobbled together over decades.

name: BLUE AND ORANGE HABITAT
text: A standard housing module showing its age. The
lower half is painted a cheerful orange,
contrasting with the faded blue above.

name: GROUND LEVEL DWELLING
text: This dwelling sits at ground level, its
entrance framed by utility panels. A warm
light spills from the open doorway, suggesting
someone is home.

name: ROOFTOP GARDEN AREA
text: A small collection of potted plants on a
corrugated metal roof. Even here, people find
ways to bring a touch of green into their
lives.

name: LOWER ALLEY STRUCTURE
text: The dark, blocky shape of another building
forms the lower edge of this alleyway. A
ventilation unit hums quietly near its base.

name: CLOTHESLINE WITH LAUNDRY
text: A string of laundry dries in the ambient glow.
A striped shirt, pants, and socks sway gently,
a mundane sight in this metallic landscape.

name: ALLEYWAY PASSAGE
text: A narrow gap between structures leading deeper
into the settlement. Paving stones line the
path, illuminated by scattered lights.

name: POTTED PLANTS CLUSTER
text: Several terracotta pots sit on the balcony,
holding hardy-looking plants. They seem to
thrive despite the dim light and metallic
surroundings.

name: AIR CONDITIONING UNIT
text: A bulky, grey climate control unit sits on a
wooden crate. Its fan blades are still,
perhaps waiting for warmer weather.

name: DUMPSTER AND TRASH
text: A large green dumpster sits in the corner,
with a few stray bags of garbage nearby. It's
a necessary part of keeping the settlement
clean.

name: HANGING LAUNDRY SHIRTS
text: A few shirts and pants are pegged to a line
stretched between buildings. They are simple
garments, worn and practical.

name: ALLEYWAY CLOTHESLINE
text: Another line of laundry stretches across the
alleyway, catching the light from a nearby
window. It's a sign of everyday life
continuing in this tough environment.

name: WOODEN COURTYARD BENCH
text: A simple wooden bench rests against the wall,
offering a place to sit. It looks well-used, a
spot for a quick rest or a chat with a
neighbor.

name: DRYING SHIRT AND PANTS
text: A white shirt and a pair of dark pants are
strung up to dry. They flap slightly, perhaps
from a breeze or a passing ventilation fan.
